detail-or-main.wrongChoice: Community trust and financial discipline help stores survive.
detail-or-main.mistakeNote: Picks a broad main-idea sentence when asked for a supporting detail.

problem-only.wrongChoice: "Kapag hindi siya nakadalo, halos walang nakagagawa ng ibang tungkulin."
problem-only.mistakeNote: Picks the sentence that names only the original problem as the topic sentence.

unsupported-motive.wrongChoice: She rejected the original proposals because of severe budget limitations.
unsupported-motive.mistakeNote: Adds a reason no detail gives.

one-detail-preference.wrongChoice: She favors youth athletic activities over local agricultural projects.
one-detail-preference.mistakeNote: Stretches one detail into a preference.

too-narrow.wrongChoice: Cleaning Plastic: The Project's Only Environmental Goal
too-narrow.mistakeNote: Names one detail and calls it the only goal.

too-broad.wrongChoice: The Complete History of Quezon Fishpond Construction
too-broad.mistakeNote: Covers a much larger subject than the passage.

one-side-only.wrongChoice: Safe nearby recreation was a need identified by the youth.
one-side-only.mistakeNote: Takes one group's supporting point as the whole passage's main idea.

detail-as-rule.wrongChoice: Weekly wholesale buying is the only requirement for survival.
detail-as-rule.mistakeNote: Turns one detail into the only rule.

points-forward.wrongChoice: Visits to collect a completed sample; comparison of two services.
points-forward.mistakeNote: Links the pointing phrase to a later action instead of what came before.

pattern-inside.wrongChoice: Visits made after revision of the instructions; cause and effect.
pattern-inside.mistakeNote: Names a pattern inside the passage instead of the one organizing it.

units-not-counts.mistakeNote: Subtracts unit counts and skips the scale.

same-morning.mistakeNote: Opens the window on the high days instead of the following morning.
